stories.title: Sources: Clowney returns to roots, joins Texans
stories.summary: Jadeveon Clowney is returning to the Texans, the team that selected him No. 1 in the 2014 NFL draft, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo on Sunday.

stories.title: Rays acquire Peralta from Mets, bolster rotation
stories.summary: The Rays are acquiring Freddy Peralta in a trade with the Mets in a move that gives Tampa Bay one of the AL's best rotations for the stretch run.

stories.title: Fever loss draws rallies for, against Cunningham
stories.summary: A crowd of critics and supporters of Indiana guard Sophie Cunningham's stance on transgender participation in women's sports gathered around and inside Target Center in Minneapolis as the Indiana Fever lost 108-100 to the Minnesota Lynx on Sunday.
